items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: You'll find it on Pete Lehmann's, Pete Lehmann's the officer.

ctx.x: Where? Oh, I thought you, in this picture, Abbie's not in there, huh?

No, you asked me about each individual one played in that band. I just wanted to do the drum roll. Well, maybe it was saying one of these pictures. You, you'll run against it if you get enough of that stuff there. You'll find it on Pete Lehmann's, Pete Lehmann's the officer. It's the same man.
I think you think you'll find him right there. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
